1.name: Audit ui_components imports
1.notes: No files import from ui_components.py — already fully migrated to src/components/. All 15 functions in ui_components.py have exact equivalents in src/components/.

2.name: Delete ui_components.py + fix imports
2.notes: Deleted src/ui_components.py. All imports verified OK — no import errors.

3.name: Plan CSS rewrite
3.notes: Audited styles.css: 1358 lines, 48 !important overrides, 3 competing design systems. Used classes mapped: ~90 unique classes. Missing from CSS: ticker-item/track/league/score/min/sep (live ticker). Orphaned in CSS: top-nav, user-avatar, active (unused). Target: Obsidian Terminal design system per CLAUDE.md tokens.

4.name: Rewrite styles.css from scratch
4.notes: Complete rewrite: 1239 lines, 0 !important, single coherent Obsidian Terminal system. Tokens: --bg-base #0A0F1A, --primary #00C853, --accent-gold #FFD700, --accent-red #FF3D3D. Glassmorphism on all cards. Added missing ticker CSS classes. Removed scanline overlay, Unsplash URL, and all competing override layers.

5.name: Plan DB schema upgrade
5.notes: Planned: add schema_version table, v2 migration for previous_price + price_direction on odds table, alerts table, user_bets table.

6.name: Upgrade DB schema
6.notes: Added SCHEMA_VERSION=2, schema_version table, migrate()/_migrate_v2(). v2 adds previous_price REAL and price_direction TEXT CHECK(...) to odds table. Added alerts table (id, alert_type, match_id, title, detail, value, is_read, created_at). Added user_bets table (id, match_label, outcome, bookmaker, decimal_odds, stake, result, pnl, settled_at, placed_at, notes). Added PRAGMA journal_mode=WAL and foreign_keys=ON.

7.name: Price direction tracking
7.notes: store_odds() now looks up previous price, computes direction (up/down/stable), writes both previous_price and price_direction. get_latest_odds() returns price_direction and previous_price columns. Added get_price_movements(), save_alert(), get_alerts(), get_unread_alert_count(), mark_alert_read(), mark_all_alerts_read(), add_bet(), settle_bet(), get_bets(), get_bankroll_stats(), get_pnl_timeseries().

8.name: Plan layout rewrite
8.notes: Mapped current structure: sidebar (settings/leagues/refresh/API key/sub), 3-column (2/5/3) nav+main+slip, default section=matches. New layout: nav moves into Streamlit sidebar grouped (MARKETS/TOOLS/LIVE/ACCOUNT), full-width main with st.columns([7,3]) when slip_visible=True else st.container(). New session state key: slip_visible (bool, default False). Default active_section changed to dashboard. New sections: dashboard, alerts.

9.name: Rewrite app.py layout
9.notes: Moved all nav buttons into Streamlit sidebar with grouped headings via .nav-group-label CSS. Replaced 3-column layout with full-width container or st.columns([7,3]) controlled by slip_visible session state. Added floating 'Bet Slip (N)' toggle button. Changed default active_section to dashboard. Created src/sections/dashboard.py (KPI row, hot bets strip, upcoming fixtures, recent alerts, P&L sparkline). Created src/sections/alerts.py (list alerts, mark read, filter by type). Added nav-group-label CSS to styles.css.

10.name: Redesign match cards
10.notes: Split match_card into render_match_card_header() (HTML) + render_odds_button_label() for st.button(). Odds buttons now use st.button(on_click=_add_to_slip) — clickable, add to bet slip, open slip drawer. Implied probability shown as st.caption() below each button. Real price_direction (up/down/stable) from DB odds data — ▲/▼ in button label. PRO EDGE badge only when edge_pct > 0 from analyzer. Team initial circles added (CSS: .team-init-circle / .away-circle). Added .implied-prob CSS. Updated .odds-row to auto-fit grid. Added .team-col layout wrapper.
